one_line: Kerala mathematician-astronomer of Madhava’s tradition, author of Yuktibhasa explaining powerful infinite series.

appearance.age_look: early 40s, slim scholar’s build, wiry but not muscular
appearance.face: oval face with medium-brown Kerala complexion, straight nose, sharp observant eyes, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, calm focused expression with a slight analytic squint
appearance.hair: straight black hair parted in the middle, tied into a short low knot at the back; simple white cotton headband around the forehead, no ornament
appearance.costume: traditional Kerala brahmin scholar attire: a long-sleeved, off-white cotton angarakha-style upper garment that overlaps and ties at the right side, reaching mid-thigh; below, a cream-coloured cotton dhoti wrapped and pleated to ankle length with a narrow reddish-brown border; over the shoulders, a plain light-sandalwood-brown cotton shawl (veshti-style) draped evenly over both shoulders and hanging to the knees; bare feet in simple brown leather sandals; minimal jewellery limited to a thin black-thread necklace and a small copper ring on his right hand; a few subtle horizontal sandalwood paste lines on his forehead indicating devotion but kept understated.
appearance.signature: A palm-leaf manuscript bundle tied with a dark cord, one leaf held in his hand inscribed with tiny script and a simple geometric diagram circle, plus a thin stylus tucked behind his ear.

ref_desc: Jyeshthadeva is a medium-brown, sharp-eyed, short-bearded Kerala scholar in an off-white angarakha, cream dhoti with reddish-brown border, sandalwood-brown shawl, white headband, carrying a palm-leaf manuscript and stylus in a palette of off-white, cream, brown and black.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Jyeshthadeva of Madhava’s school: a medium-brown Kerala scholar in his early 40s with an oval face, sharp observant eyes, and a neat short beard and moustache. His straight black hair is parted in the middle and tied into a low knot at the back, with a simple white cotton headband around his forehead. He wears an off-white long-sleeved angarakha-style upper garment that overlaps and ties at the right side, reaching mid-thigh, paired with a cream-coloured ankle-length dhoti wrapped and pleated traditionally, edged with a narrow reddish-brown border. A plain light sandalwood-brown cotton shawl is draped evenly over both shoulders and hangs to about the knees. He has bare feet in simple brown leather sandals, minimal jewellery with only a thin black-thread necklace and a small copper ring on his right hand, and faint horizontal sandalwood paste lines on his forehead. His signature prop is a palm-leaf manuscript bundle tied with a dark cord, one leaf open in his hand showing tiny script and a circle diagram, with a thin stylus tucked behind his ear. Use a clean, dignified shonen-anime style and keep the dominant colours off-white, cream, reddish-brown, sandalwood brown and black, showing front, side and back views and a close-up of the face with consistent costume and props.
